name: @intellectual-frontiers/archon-dialect-native-pinned
description: The default dialect of tools for Archon: the programs a computer needs, as their publishers released them, pinned by the SHA-256 of the artifact, in a folder of the user's own, with no administrator rights and no package manager; never built from source.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
